input: I am writing to express my extreme frustration with my recent order. As a first-time buyer, I expected a smoother experience, but I am now facing a $5.00 cancellation fee because my order status changed to "Processing" before I could finalize my decision. I understand this is standard procedure, but given that I have never purchased from Northwind Outdoor before, I am asking if there is any way to waive this fee as a gesture of goodwill for a new customer. I am not asking for a full refund, just a waiver of the penalty. Additionally, I am concerned about the payment verification process. I was told that new cards must be verified within 48 hours to avoid automatic cancellation. I have already submitted my card details, but I am worried that if I miss this window, I will lose my order entirely. Please let me know if there is any flexibility in these policies, as I am eager to complete my purchase but feel that the current terms are overly rigid for a first-time customer. I look forward to your prompt response.

If the ticket asks for more than one piece of information, cover them all.

Citation discipline. Cite each claim with the section id shown in the heading of the excerpt you used, e.g. [returns]. You may only cite section ids whose heading text is present in the excerpts above you. Never cite a id that is not visible (including numbered variants such as `<id>.1`). Never assert a policy detail that is not literally in the excerpts. If a needed fact is absent from the excerpts, do not fill it in — say which specific fact the excerpts do not contain and offer to escalate the ticket to a human agent.

Do not hedge the facts. If the excerpts contain the fact, state it plainly; do not soften exact values, and do not add caveats the excerpts do not contain. Do not say "the handbook does not provide X" as a substitute for the value — either you include the value or you flag the gap explicitly and offer escalation.

Be direct and concise. Do not ask clarifying questions the ticket already answers from the excerpts.
